title: Outrageously Crunchy British Chicken Wings Trifle
description: A salty and crunchy British dish featuring chicken wings in a trifle form, infused with kombu cold extract and ayurvedic rajasic friendly ingredients, served in a bamboo tray.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together kombu cold extract, ayurvedic spice blend, sea salt, and black pepper.
Add the chicken wings to the bowl and toss to coat evenly with the marinade.
Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and arrange the chicken wings in a single layer.
Drizzle the olive oil over the chicken wings and sprinkle with minced garlic.
Bake the chicken wings in the preheated oven for 30 minutes or until cooked through.
While the chicken wings are baking, heat about 1/2 inch of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the thinly sliced onion to the skillet and cook until crispy and golden brown.
To assemble the trifle, place a layer of crunchy fried onions at the bottom of the bamboo tray.
Add a layer of baked chicken wings on top of the onions, followed by a layer of crispy onion slices and chopped parsley.
